verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is a SaaS platform with built-in AI features (e.g. 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data'), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions data-use policies, model-training opt-outs, or customer-data exclusion from AI training. The AI-tool visibility and access controls cover employees' third-party app usage, not Rippling's own handling of customer data.
